description: This file defines the ShippingQuoteModule interface, which declares methods for validating configurations, retrieving custom configurations, and obtaining shipping quotes within the shipping module of the sales management system.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteModule
classes.description: This interface declares methods related to obtaining shipping quotes, validating configurations, and custom configuration retrieval for shipping modules.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the shipping module configuration using the provided integration configuration and merchant store.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom shipping module configuration for a given merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Calculates and returns a list of shipping options and quotes based on provided packages, order total, delivery details, store, configuration, module, shipping configuration, and locale.
